query: I just tried the new matcha latte at the café down the street this morning, it was so creamy and had just the right amount of sweetness, I’m definitely going back for another one tomorrow. I also finally finished that cozy mystery novel I’ve been reading for weeks, the ending was such a fun twist I never saw the villain coming at all. My cat also knocked over my potted succulent last night, I spent half an hour cleaning up soil off the kitchen floor, I think I need to move all the plants to a higher shelf now. Anyway, I’m having some trouble with my phone right now: my APN MMS settings aren’t working at all, my data mode is turned off, I’m currently abroad and I have roaming switched off, can you help me figure out what’s going on?
